subject: CloudRidge discovery recap — economic buyer, security gates, champion asks
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudRidge discovery recap — economic buyer, security gates, champion asks

Team — quick recap from the 30-min discovery with CloudRidge (Alex Marsh, Emily Cho). High level then clear next steps so we can arm their internal champion. Notes below:  

Context:
- Use-case: internal customer support assistant (multi-tenant), will run on midsize LLMs for generation + embeddings for retrieval. P95 latency matters (customer experience).
- They currently run a hybrid approach (on-prem embeddings + cloud gen).

Decision criteria (explicit / high priority):
- Latency under 250ms for 512-token avg responses at p95.
- Unit inference cost (per 1M tokens) and predictable monthly bills.
- SOC2 + data residency (EU data at rest option later) + SSO/SAML.

Stakeholders called out on today’s call:
- Alex Marsh (Director of AI) — technical champion (external). Wants perf / integration guide and quick POC plan.
- Emily Cho — procurement coordinator (external). Wants procurement timeline and contract template.
- Economic buyer: Marta Ruiz (CFO) — not on call. Alex says Marta will need an annualized cost/benefit summary and clear payback (<12 months ideally).

Key asks from CloudRidge we promised to follow up on:
1) Short ROI one-pager for Marta (single page, exec-friendly with topline numbers + 12-month savings).
2) SOC 2 report + data residency statement and short SSO/SCIM summary.
3) Pricing for a 12-month dedicated capacity commitment + an estimated monthly run-rate for hosted API alternative.
4) Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: POC -> Procurement -> Legal -> Prod launch.

Immediate next steps (owner):
- Ben: build the ROI one-pager + TCO model with 3 scenarios (hosted, dedicated small commit, dedicated with quantization). Attach stubs in email. Due: EOD Tue (6/1).
- Jordan: prep 1-page procurement checklist and term summary; get our standard procurement timeline and contract cadence. Due: Mon (5/31).
- Laura: draft a short champion playbook (talk tracks for Alex to send to Marta + targeted ROI bullets). Due: Mon (5/31).
- Me (Vanessa): consolidate and send to Alex & Emily by EOD Tue with MAP + ask for ideal procurement dates.

Attachments referenced below: RDW_ROI_onepager_CloudRidge.pdf (placeholder), RDW_TCO_model_CloudRidge.xlsx.

Quick callouts for talk tracks (to help Laura/Ben):
- Focus Marta on cash flow: one-year net savings and projected avoidance of infra spend if they move inference to dedicated pools.
- Highlight reliability: guaranteed SLOs with Dedicated + transparent fallback to hosted if capacity spikes.
- Security: SOC 2 and optional VPC/private control plane—call out audit trail capability.

I’ll draft the outbound note to Alex/Emily once we have Ben’s ROI draft + Jordan’s procurement checklist.

Thanks — Van

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0113
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudRidge discovery recap — economic buyer, security gates, champion asks

Got it — I’ll take procurement checklist and contract cadence. Couple quick clarifications:
- Do we have a standard DocuSign link with our redlines already applied for dedicated commitments, or should I start from the standard enterprise template?
- For procurement timeline: Alex asked for a 6–8 week procurement window (they said "as fast as legal moves"). I’ll map our typical milestones + a compression path if they want expedited review.

Also adding a short note for the outbound to Alex: include an optional cost comparison for 12 months hosted vs 12-month reserved (monthly amortized cost) — that usually helps Marta see predictability benefit.

I’ll have the checklist and contract note by Mon EOD.

--
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 17:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudRidge discovery recap — CloudRidge ROI drafts attached

Attaching first drafts. I put conservative/likely/aggressive scenarios in the TCO model. Topline bullets for the exec one-pager (drafted) — please edit for voice:  

- Baseline: CloudRidge current monthly inference spend est. $55k (embeds + gen).
- Hosted (12 mo): estimated annual spend ~ $660k (variable, higher peak exposure).
- Dedicated small-commit: estimated annualized spend ~ $420k (projected ~36% cost reduction vs hosted); amortized commit + support.
- Ops savings & dev velocity: expected 30% reduction in runtimes for support bot dev (fewer infra tickets) => estimated $40k/yr ops savings.
- Net first-year benefit (dedicated commit vs hosted): ~$280k; payback ~4–6 months depending on commit level & POC outcomes.

Champion talk tracks (for Alex to use with Marta):
1) "Moving to a dedicated pool reduces per-token variance and gives predictable budgeting — your finance team can forecast with confidence."
2) "We’ll provide a one-page P&L that shows reduced unit costs and ops savings — payback typically inside the first year for customers of your size."
3) "We support SOC 2 controls, SSO, and VPC options; we’ll align the MAP to show delivery of those security gates before go-live."

Attachments: RDW_ROI_onepager_CloudRidge.pdf (one-pager), RDW_TCO_model_CloudRidge.xlsx (spreadsheet), pricing-sheet-redwood-dedicated.pdf (detailed pricing).

Flagging two questions for legal/procurement coordination:
- Any standard clause we should offer for data residency (EU-only at rest) as an optional addendum?
- Do we have an expedited SLA review path for finance-led procurement (Marta) — Jordan, you may already know.

If everyone OK, I’ll push final versions to Van for outbound.

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachment: [RDW_ROI_onepager_CloudRidge.pdf (pdf)]
Attachment: [RDW_TCO_model_CloudRidge.xlsx (xlsx)]
Attachment: [pricing-sheet-redwood-dedicated.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alex Marsh <alex.marsh@cloudridge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Emily Cho <emily.cho@cloudridge.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@cloudridge.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudRidge discovery recap — economic buyer, security gates, champion asks

Vanessa / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Ben’s topline numbers look reasonable and exactly the sort of thing Marta will want to see. Next asks from us:  

1) Please send SOC 2 report and a short data residency statement we can send to internal legal.
2) SSO/SCIM integration guide (1-pager) — our infra team will validate provisioning.
3) Can we get the MAP with milestone dates? Procurement wants to tentatively target a kickoff week of 6/14 and legal review by 6/28.

I’ll introduce Marta to the ROI one-pager; Emily and I will compile an internal checklist and push to procurement once we have SOC 2 & data residency statement. Appreciate the tight timeline.

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Marsh
Director of AI, CloudRidge
alex.marsh@cloudridge.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
